newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Indexes slow ahead of expiration.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Indexes slow ahead of expiration.

text.p: Trading in index options was relatively quiet as expiration week began, traders said Monday.
"What I'm seeing and hearing is there isn't much going on," one index broker in Chicago said.
January options expire at the end of the week.
One index options trader in Chicago said that the combination of Friday's wild market swings and Monday's narrow range trading kept activity relatively sluggish.
"This morning there was some action, but after that it's been really quiet," he said.
By late trading, the bellwether Dow industrial average was down 13 points at about 6,690, having traded between 6,706 and 6,734.
The broader S&P 100 index lost 1.61 to 743.33 and the S&P 500 index was off 1.43 at 758.07.

Traders said that even though January options were losing premium as their expiration approached, prices remained relatively strong because of the possibility of sharp market moves as the week unfolded.
On Friday, the Dow fell around 67 points in early trading before finally closing up 78 to a record.
"You've still got 700 puts that could be in the money," the trader said.
Among OEX options, the January 730 put traded about 17,260 contracts. The contract, which had open interest of 23,418, including an addition of 7,073 contracts Friday, ell 3/4 to 2-3/16.
The January 740 put traded about 12,830 contracts and the January 745 put traded 10,580.
On the call side, the January 745 saw most of the activity, with 13,860 contracts changing hands. It still had 15,144 contracts open through Friday.
In the February series, the busiest OEX options included the 710 put, the 790 call and the 675 put.
Overall, OEX put volume outpaced call volume by 94,561 to 77,670 in late trading.
A similar pattern was seen in SPX options on the Chicago Board Options Exchange, where put volume beat call volume by 59,849 to 33,588.
The SPX January 760 call was most active, with volume of about 10,650. The January 750 put traded 10,330.
